agreement_type.name: Educational Affiliation Agreement for Student Internships
agreement_type.description: Clinical/practicum placement agreement between Exos and a university or college.

entries.label: Parties & Recitals
entries.description: Who is bound; the Institution/Company/Student framing.

entries.label: Term
entries.description: Initial term and effective date.

entries.label: Renewal / Auto-Renewal
entries.description: Whether and how the agreement renews.

entries.label: Termination for Convenience
entries.description: Non-renewal / no-fault exit and notice period.

entries.label: Termination for Cause
entries.description: Breach, cure period, immediate termination triggers. Not what survives termination (see survival).

entries.label: Indemnification
entries.description: Who bears third-party claim risk; mutual vs one-way.

entries.label: Insurance
entries.description: Required coverage types and limits; student health insurance.

entries.label: Governing Law
entries.description: Which state's law governs.

entries.label: Assignment
entries.description: A party's transfer of the agreement, or of its rights and obligations, to another entity: consent to assign, change of control, affiliate and merger carve-outs. Not the assignment or placement of students to sites or programs (see supervision_evaluation and program_administration).

entries.label: Confidentiality
entries.description: Confidential Information definition and obligations.

entries.label: FERPA / Student Records
entries.description: Handling of education records under FERPA.

entries.label: HIPAA / PHI
entries.description: Protected health information; business-associate status.

entries.label: Data Privacy & Security
entries.description: Data protection beyond FERPA/HIPAA.

entries.label: Background Checks
entries.description: Right to screen students before placement: criminal, drug and identity screening, and the host's right to refuse a student on a screening result. Immunizations and other health clearance belong to student_health_and_safety, and refusal on other grounds to student_access_and_removal.

entries.label: Supervision & Evaluation
entries.description: Coordinators, day-to-day supervision, student evaluation and grading. Not the host's right to refuse or remove a student (see student_access_and_removal) or its operating terms and joint program review (see program_administration).

entries.label: Student Responsibilities
entries.description: A student's own conduct duties: conduct, timeliness, uniforms, confidentiality. Not emergency care for an injured student (see student_health_and_safety).

entries.label: Relationship of Parties
entries.description: No employment/partnership; students not employees; a statement that the parties may deal with others (non-exclusivity).

entries.label: Non-Discrimination
entries.description: Anti-discrimination obligations.

entries.label: Remuneration / No-Pay
entries.description: Whether students are paid; no-payment-between-parties.

entries.label: Notices
entries.description: Notice addresses and method.

entries.label: Severability
entries.description: Severance of an invalid or unenforceable provision so the rest of the agreement continues in force. Not what continues after expiry or termination (see survival).

entries.label: Entire Agreement
entries.description: Integration / merger clause.

entries.label: Amendments
entries.description: How the agreement may be modified.

entries.label: Accreditation & Licensure
entries.description: Both parties' duty to maintain licensure, accreditation and similar qualifications. Not compliance with law or program eligibility (see compliance_with_laws).

entries.label: Limitation of Liability
entries.description: Liability caps and exclusions (often absent; flag if introduced).

entries.label: IP Ownership Assignment
entries.description: Who owns work product, materials and other intellectual property created in the placement, including assignment of it to a party by a participant who is not a contracting party, such as a student assigning rights to the host or the school.

entries.label: Compliance with Laws & Program Eligibility
entries.description: The parties state, represent or covenant that the arrangement and their performance conform to applicable law, regulation and accreditation requirements, including healthcare fraud-and-abuse and referral rules; a party represents that it is not excluded or otherwise ineligible to take part in government healthcare or payment programs and must notify the other if that changes; cooperation with a party's compliance program; change-in-law or illegality mechanics (suspend, renegotiate or terminate). Not discrimination rules (non_discrimination), privacy statutes (ferpa_student_records, hipaa_phi, data_privacy_security) or licensure and accreditation status (accreditation_licensure).

entries.label: Student Site Access & Removal
entries.description: Which areas, clients and activities of the host site a placed student may access; the host's right to refuse entry to, suspend, or require withdrawal of a student on safety, health, conduct, competence or policy grounds; whether that discretion is sole or reasonable, and any duty to consult or notify the school first. Not refusal that rests on a pre-placement screening result (background_checks), the student's own conduct duties (student_responsibilities) or ending the whole agreement (termination_cause, termination_convenience).

entries.label: Survival & Effect of Termination
entries.description: Which rights and obligations continue after expiry, non-renewal or termination, and for how long (typically indemnities, confidentiality, records and accrued liabilities), and general statements of what ends on termination. Not the right to terminate or its notice and cure mechanics (termination_cause, termination_convenience) and not severance of an invalid provision (severability).

entries.label: Student Health & Safety
entries.description: Safety and infection-control training (occupational safety, bloodborne pathogens), exposure-incident handling, emergency or urgent care for a student hurt or taken ill on site and who pays for it, and health prerequisites for placement such as immunizations or health clearance. Not health insurance (insurance) and not criminal, drug or identity screening (background_checks).

entries.label: Program Administration & Host Operational Control
entries.description: Operating terms of the placement program that are neither student duties nor supervision: the host's discretion over how many students it accepts and when, its retained authority over its own operations and client care, the facilities, space and resources it makes available, the school's right to visit or inspect the site, and periodic joint review and coordination meetings on the affiliation. Not day-to-day supervision and grading (supervision_evaluation), student duties (student_responsibilities), or financial audit and purchase-volume commitments (audit_rights and minimum_commitment, which stay inactive).

entries.label: Most Favored Nation
entries.description: Not applicable to affiliation agreements.

entries.label: Non-Compete
entries.description: Superseded by Non-Exclusive; flag if a true non-compete appears.

entries.label: Exclusivity
entries.description: Agreements are expressly non-exclusive; a statement that the parties may deal with others is filed under relationship_of_parties.

entries.label: License Grant
entries.description: Not typical.

entries.label: Minimum Commitment
entries.description: Placement counts are discretionary, not committed; host discretion over capacity is filed under program_administration.

entries.label: Price Restrictions
entries.description: No pricing; no-pay arrangement.

entries.label: Audit Rights
entries.description: Not a financial audit; the site-inspection right is filed under program_administration.

entries.label: Warranty Duration
entries.description: Not applicable.

7.1. Definition. “ Confidential Information ” means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party’s possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.   

7.2. Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it.  The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

prior_standards.text:
4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos. “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

vs_standard.reason: One-way protection of our information with a broad definition and a full student confidentiality agreement, in place of our mutual clause.

parts.reason: Covers all information we disclose including PHI regardless of labeling, one-way, with no general exclusions for the institution and narrower student exclusions requiring written-record proof.

Obligations run one way to protect only our information, binding students to reasonable care, program-only use and certified return or destruction with no backup-copy carve-out, and we owe no reciprocal duties.

additions.summary: Gives us demand-for-return, damages, injunctive relief and non-waiver remedies for a student breach.
Makes the student's obligations survive the end of the program.

prior_standards.text:
This Educational Affiliation Agreement for Student Internships ("Agreement") is made effective this January 2, 2024 ("Effective Date") by and between [Exos affiliate], together with its affiliates ("Exos") and Counterparty-4 (the "Institution").
A. The Institution administers educational curricula for students pursuing careers in physical therapy, exercise science or other related health professions (each referenced herein as "Student," collectively, "Students"), and seeks to provide, as part of the educational curricula, supervised clinical experiences for Students at Exos' facilities (the "Program");
B. Exos seeks to provide Students of the Institution with supervised experiences at the Exos facilities, consistent with the educational objectives of the Institution; and
C. Exos and the Institution have determined that each may best accomplish its objectives by mutual assistance and seek to describe their affiliation in this Agreement.
In consideration of the mutual promises and conditions in this Agreement, Exos and the Institution agree as follows:
STUDENT CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT This Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Student Confidentiality Agreement") is made and entered into freely and voluntarily by [INSERT STUDENT NAME] ("Student") in relation to the educational internship program (the "Program") between [INSERT SCHOOL] (the "Institution") and Athletes' Performance, Inc. ("Exos"), as memorialized in the Educational Affiliation Agreement for Student Internships.
BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE. As further described in the Educational Affiliation Agreement for Student Internships between the Institution and Exos, Student has been given the opportunity to conduct an internship at respective Exos facility as part of the Program. As part of this internship, Exos may disclose to Student certain valuable confidential and proprietary information that must be protected.

2.4. Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to Exos shall be required to complete the Exos’s training and adhere to the Exos' rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students’ immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6. Student Access to Exos and Clients. Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students’ clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. Exos reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Exos’ reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS’ RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and Exos shall instruct Students regarding Students’ responsibilities associated with the Program at Exos facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1. Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2. Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3. Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5. Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student’s personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6. Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.

47 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shal! not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION, At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. if Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

7. Confidentiality.

Definition. "Confidential Information" means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party's possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.
Obligations. - Provide information reasonably requested about Students to enable Exos to evaluate their candidacy. - Ensure Students are prepared for the Program by qualified faculty, with measured academic performance. - Coordinator to manage Students’ educational experiences for the Program. - Maintain accreditations/ licenses required of an educational institution. | - Determine which Students may participate in the Program and assign them to a Facility. - Offer Students clinical experiences meeting accreditation standards. - Appoint “Facility Coordinator” to oversee clinical experience and enable Student activities based on the agreed objectives. - Orient Students to the Program and applicable Exos rules and policies. - Maintain qualifications/ licenses required to provide clinical experiences to Students. - Promptly notify Institution of any student injuries, and arrange medical care per its policies, but without financial responsibility. | - Meet periodically to review  key Program objectives. - Cooperate to supervise and evaluate Students, including providing feedback on Student’s performance throughout the Program.

B. For Cause. This Agreement may be terminated for cause as follows:
By either party, upon the other party's breach of this Agreement; provided the non-breaching party provides at least 30 days' notice and opportunity to cure (if such breach is capable of cure, and otherwise such termination shall be immediately effective).

B. For Cause. In the event the Institution or Exos fails in any substantial manner to perform as required herein, this Agreement may be terminated as described below:
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, upon material breach of any of its provisions by the other party; provided, however, that not less than thirty (30) days prior to termination, written notice shall be given by the non-breaching party to the breaching party that states the intention of the non-breaching party to terminate this Agreement, the nature of the material breach giving rise to termination and shall permit the breaching party reasonable opportunity to cure such material breach during said thirty (30) day period (" Cure Period ").
If the material breach is not resolved to the satisfaction of the non-breaching party during the Cure Period as provided in Section 6.2 (B)(1) above, the non-breaching party may immediately terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the breaching party.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. RECITALS
A. The Institution administers educational curricula for students pursuing careers in physical therapy, exercise science or other related health professions (each referenced herein as "Student," collectively, "Students"), and seeks to provide, as part of the educational curricula, supervised clinical experiences for Students at Exos' facilities (the "Program");

signed_text.text:
1.1 Preparation of Students for Exos Placement. The Institution shall assure, through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities. Upon any such placement,, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. The term "Affiliate" means an entity as of or after the Effective Date owned by, controlling, controlled by, or under common control with, directly or indirectly, a party, whether through ownership of voting securities or other equity interest, representation on its board of directors or other governing body, or by contract.
2.1 Clinical Experience. Exos shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2 Number of Placements. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students onsite at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.
2.9 Inspections. Exos shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10 Final Authority. Exos retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of Exos, including all aspects of client care.
3.2 Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

NON-EXCLUSIVE. The parties agree that the Institution shall be free to enter into similar agreements with other entities, and that Exos shall be free to enter into similar agreements with other educational institutions.
RELATIONSHIP OF PARTIES. Nothing in this Agreement is intended or shall be construed to create a joint venture relationship, employment relationship, a partnership, a lease, or a landlord/tenant relationship. Should any governmental agency question or challenge the relationship of the parties of this Agreement, both the Institution and Exos, upon receipt by either of them of notice, shall promptly notify the other party and afford the other party the opportunity to participate in any government agency discussion or negotiations, irrespective of how such discussions are initiated. Students are not employees of Exos, and, consequently are not covered by its workers' compensation or unemployment insurance programs.

1.2 Safety and Related Training. The Institution will provide Students with information and training regarding universal precautions which include, without limitation: (i) the hazards associated with blood and other potentially infectious materials; (ii) protective measures to be taken to minimize the risk of occupational exposure to blood borne pathogens; and (iii) appropriate action to take in an emergency involving exposure to blood and other potentially infectious materials.
5.1 Emergency Medical Services. If Student is injured or becomes ill while at the Exos facility, Exos shall provide emergency or urgent medical care as appropriate, consistent with Exos's capability and policies. In the event Exos renders emergency or urgent medical care to Student, Exos shall promptly notify the Institution that Student has been injured or become ill. Exos shall bear no financial responsibility for charges associated with said injury, illness or treatment, unless due to the negligence of Exos.
5.2 Immunizations. The Institution shall assure that Students have received, before reporting to Exos, appropriate immunizations and vaccines.
5.3 OSHA Compliance. The Institution shall instruct Students regarding precautions and other procedures to protect Students, Exos's clients and Exos personnel in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration ("OSHA") regulations.

2.4 Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to Exos shall be required to complete the Exos's training and adhere to the Exos' rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students' immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6 Student Access to Exos and Clients. Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. Exos reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Exos' reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS' RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and Exos shall instruct Students regarding Students' responsibilities associated with the Program at Exos facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.
4.7 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.

DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. BREACH. 16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

The Institution will provide Students with information and training regarding universal precautions which include, without limitation: (i) the hazards associated with blood and other potentially infectious materials; (ii) protective measures to be taken to minimize the risk of occupational exposure to blood borne pathogens; and (iii) appropriate action to take in an emergency involving exposure to blood and other potentially infectious materials.
5.1 Emergency Medical Services. If Student is injured or becomes ill while at the Exos facility, Exos shall provide emergency or urgent medical care as appropriate, consistent with Exos's capability and policies. In the event Exos renders emergency or urgent medical care to Student, Exos shall promptly notify the Institution that Student has been injured or become ill. Exos shall bear no financial responsibility for charges associated with said injury, illness or treatment.
5.2 Immunizations. The Institution shall assure that Students have received, before reporting to Exos, appropriate immunizations and vaccines.
5.3 OSHA Compliance. The Institution shall instruct Students regarding precautions and other procedures to protect Students, Exos's clients and Exos personnel in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration ("OSHA") regulations.

2.4 Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to Exos shall be required to complete the Exos's training and adhere to the Exos' rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students' immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6 Student Access to Exos and Clients. Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. Exos reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Exos' reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS' RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and Exos shall instruct Students regarding Students' responsibilities associated with the Program at Exos facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

The Institution shall assure, through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities. Upon any such placement,, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. The term "Affiliate" means an entity as of or after the Effective Date owned by, controlling, controlled by, or under common control with, directly or indirectly, a party, whether through ownership of voting securities or other equity interest, representation on its board of directors or other governing body, or by contract.
2.1 Clinical Experience. Exos shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2 Number of Placements. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students onsite at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.
2.9 Inspections. Exos shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10 Final Authority. Exos retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of Exos, including all aspects of client care.
3.2 Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

1.2 Safety and Related Training. The Institution will provide Students with information and training regarding universal precautions which include, without limitation: (i) the hazards associated with blood and other potentially infectious materials; (ii) protective measures to be taken to minimize the risk of occupational exposure to blood borne pathogens; and (iii) appropriate action to take in an emergency involving exposure to blood and other potentially infectious materials.
5.1 Emergency Medical Services. If Student is injured or becomes ill while at the Exos facility, Exos shall provide emergency or urgent medical care as appropriate, consistent with Exos's capability and policies. In the event Exos renders emergency or urgent medical care to Student, Exos shall promptly notify the Institution that Student has been injured or become ill. Exos shall bear no financial responsibility for charges associated with said injury, illness or treatment.
5.2 Immunizations. The Institution shall assure that Students have received, before reporting to Exos, appropriate immunizations and vaccines.
5.3 OSHA Compliance. The Institution shall instruct Students regarding precautions and other procedures to protect Students, Exos's clients and Exos personnel in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration ("OSHA") regulations.

2.4 Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to Exos shall be required to complete the Exos's training and adhere to the Exos' rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students' immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6 Student Access to Exos and Clients. Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. Exos reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Exos' reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS' RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and Exos shall instruct Students regarding Students' responsibilities associated with the Program at Exos facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.
4.7 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

1.1 Preparation of Students for Exos Placement. The Institution shall assure, through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities. Upon any such placement,, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students onsite at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.

The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. 4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos. “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. Exos reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Exos' reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS' RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and Exos shall instruct Students regarding Students' responsibilities associated with the Program at Exos facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.
