16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of Exos. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner. Confidential Information must be clearly marked as "Confidential" or similar legend, or if related orally or visually, identified as Confidential at the time of disclosure and reduced to writing and delivered to Institution within 15 days of disclosure, unless such information is PHI. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by
the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Exos acknowledges that Institution is subject to the [state law] ([state law], et seq.) which shall supersede Institution's confidentiality obligations in this Section 16.1. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos's rights hereunder.

1.1 Preparation of Students for Exos Placement. The Institution shall assure, through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Upon any such placement, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, upon material breach of any of its provisions by the other party; provided, however, that not less than thirty (30) days prior to termination, written notice shall be given by the non-breaching party to the breaching party that states the intention of the non-breaching party to terminate this Agreement, the nature of the material breach giving rise to termination and shall permit the breaching party reasonable opportunity to cure such material breach during said thirty (30) day period (" Cure Period ").
If the material breach is not resolved to the satisfaction of the non-breaching party during the Cure Period as provided in Section 6.2 (B)(1) above, the non-breaching party may immediately terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the breaching party.
In the event that termination of the Agreement by Exos pursuant to this Section 6.2 (B) disrupts the clinical experience of any Student(s) in the Program, the parties shall attempt, in good faith and using their best efforts, to continue Students’ clinical experiences, and this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect until such time as this Agreement may expire without disruption of said Students’ clinical experience. During any time period in which notice of termination has been given and existing Students are completing the Program, no new Student may be placed at any Exos facility.
C. Immediate Termination. The Institution may immediately terminate this Agreement if Exos fails to maintain full and unrestricted accreditation, licensure and, if applicable, eligibility as required under Section 2.7 of this Agreement. Exos may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice to the Institution if the Institution fails to maintain full and unrestricted accreditation and licensure as required under Section 1.7 of this Agreement.

opening_text.text:
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure .	  The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos.  “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.  Students will sign and comply with Exos' Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY . Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information.  Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE . Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION .  This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student.  Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH .  If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity.  Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

signed_text.text:
1.1. Preparation of Students for Exos Placement. The Institution shall assure, through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4. Assigning Students to Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities. Upon any such placement, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) under the same terms of this Agreement, and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. The term "Affiliate" means an entity as of or after the Effective Date owned by, controlling, controlled by, or under common control with, directly or indirectly, a party, whether through ownership of voting securities or other equity interest, representation on its board of directors or other governing body, or by contract.
2.1. Clinical Experience. Exos shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2. Number of Placements. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students on-site at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.
2.9. Inspections. Exos shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10. Final Authority. Exos retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of Exos, including all aspects of client care.
3.2. Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

opening_text.text:
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos. “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

1.1 Preparation of Students for Exos Placement. The Institution shall require , through qualified faculty, that each Student assigned to an Exos facility, as mutually agreed, is adequately prepared to benefit from such assignment. Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the training Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities.
2.1 Clinical Experience. Exos shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2 Number of Placements. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students onsite at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.
2.9 Inspections. Exos shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10 Final Authority. Exos retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of Exos, including all aspects of client care.
3.2 Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

2.4 Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to Exos shall be required to complete the Exos's training and adhere to the Exos' rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students' immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6 Student Access to Exos and Clients. Exos shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of Exos as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. 4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on Exos premises, conduct themselves in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other
weapons while on the Exos premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at Exos without express written permission from Exos. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Exos facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to Exos at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform Exos and the Institution of Student's inability to report to Exos as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by Exos. Student shall display proper identification as directed by Exos.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Exos facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or Exos, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at Exos including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Exos facility and experience and supervision at the Exos facility.

signed_text.text:
Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A.
Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with the Facility's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the
information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly
demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility's rights hereunder.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.

The Facility shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of the Facility as reasonably required to support Students’ clinical development and as permitted under applicable law.  The Facility reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Facility’s reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
Conduct .  Student shall, at all times while on the Facility premises, conduct himself or herself in a professional manner.  Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Facility premises.  Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at the Facility without express written permission from the Facility.  Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Facility and the Institution.
Timeliness .  Student shall report to the Facility at the assigned place and time.  Student shall immediately inform the Facility and the Institution of Student's inability to report to the Facility as assigned.
Uniform and Identification .  Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by the Facility. Student shall display proper identification as directed by the Facility.
Personal Expenses .  While at the Facility, Student shall be responsible for Student’s personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
Evaluation of Clinical Experience .  Student shall, upon request of the Institution or the Facility, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at the Facility including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Facility and experience and supervision at the Facility.

16.1 Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with the Facility's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was
not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement;
and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility's rights hereunder.

e Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with the Facility's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility's rights hereunder.

vs_standard.reason: One-way protection of our information with a broad definition and a full student confidentiality agreement, in place of our mutual clause.

Obligations run one way to protect only our information, binding students to reasonable care, program-only use and certified return or destruction with no backup-copy carve-out, and we owe no reciprocal duties.

additions.summary: Gives us demand-for-return, damages, injunctive relief and non-waiver remedies for a student breach.
Makes the student's obligations survive the end of the program.

opening_text.text:
A. General. Clinical Site agrees to accept students from the Program for the purposes of receiving supervised training and experience. The Clinical Site will provide a planned, supervised program of clinical experience designed in cooperation with University, and will provide such clinical experience at its facilities.
B. Liaison/Staffing . The Clinical Site will designate a Program Liaison to serve as a liaison between the Clinical Site and University and to coordinate the student's clinical experience.
C. Student Rotations. The Clinical Site shall provide students with clinical rotations as agreed to by the parties.
D. Supervision. The Clinical Site shall provide or arrange for a designated practitioner ("Designated Practitioner'') to provide direct supervision and training to the students and to evaluate the students. The Clinical Site agrees that the students are not to provide any care or service to patients unless under the direct supervision of the practitioner designated by the Clinical Site. The Designated Practitioner shall have sufficient expertise in a specialized area of practice to provide guidance to the student in meeting course objectives.
F. Facilities. The Clinical Site shall arrange for students to have access to such facilities as are available and reasonably necessary for the activities of the students under this Agreement.
G. Evaluation. The Clinical Site shall require the Designated Practitioner to evaluate the performance of each student at the termination of such student's rotation and/or upon a schedule mutually agreed to by the parties, and shall provide the Program with copies of such evaluations or reports.
M. General. University shall retain full responsibility for the planning, implementation, and execution of the Program, including programming, administration, curriculum, content, grading and requirements for matriculation, promotion and graduation. University shall place students in rotations, subject to the Clinical Site's final approval.
N. Liaison. University shall designate an individual to serve as Program Designee. The Program Designee shall be the liaison between University and the Clinical Site to coordinate the clinical and academic experience of the students, and to assist the Clinical Site as necessary In operating an effective clinical program. The Program Designee shall work with the Clinical Site to coordinate student activities and training.
O. Assignment of Students. University shall, upon mutual agreement of the parties, provide to the Clinical Site (i) the number of students and the schedule of assignment (ii) the expected level of experience to which the student will be assigned; (iii) the expected learning objectives of the student; and (iv) a summary of the student's education and
clinical experience and field work, if requested by the Clinical Site.

16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information

DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by
the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility's rights hereunder.

1.1. Preparation of Students for Facility Placement. 1.4. Assigning Students to the Facility. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from the Facility, the Institution shall select Students to be assigned (with the approval of the Facility) to the Facility. The Institution shall notify the Facility of the Students assigned to the Facility, and each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences.
2.1. Clinical Experience. The Facility shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2. Number of Placements. The Facility shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students on-site at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that the Facility can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. The Facility shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to the Facility.
2.9. Inspections. The Facility shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10. Final Authority. The Facility retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of the Facility, including all aspects of client care.
3.2. Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and the Facility agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

NON-EXCLUSIVE. The parties agree that the Institution shall be free to enter into similar agreements with other entities, and that the Facility shall be free to enter into similar agreements with other educational institutions.
RELATIONSHIP OF PARTIES. Nothing in this Agreement is intended or shall be construed to create a joint venture relationship, employment relationship, a partnership, a lease, or a landlord/tenant relationship. Should any governmental agency question or challenge the relationship of the parties of this Agreement, both the Institution and the Facility, upon receipt by either of them of notice, shall promptly notify the other party and afford the other party the opportunity to participate in any government agency discussion or negotiations, irrespective of how such discussions are initiated. Students are not employees of the Facility, and, consequently are not covered by its workers' compensation or unemployment insurance programs.
DISCLAIMER OF OTHER RELATIONSHIPS. This Student Confidentiality Agreement does not create a relationship of agency, employee-employer, partnership, joint venture or license between the parties.

If Student is injured or becomes ill while at the Facility, the Facility shall provide emergency or urgent medical care as appropriate, consistent with the Facility's capability and policies. In the event the Facility renders emergency or urgent medical care to Student, the Facility shall promptly notify the Institution that Student has been injured or become ill. The Facility shall bear no financial responsibility for charges associated with said injury, illness or treatment.
5.2. Immunizations. The Institution shall assure that Students have received, before reporting to the Facility, appropriate immunizations and vaccines.

All Students assigned by the Institution to the Facility shall be required to complete the Facility's training and adhere to the Facility rules, regulations, policies and procedures. Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students' immediate removal from participation in the Program.
2.6. Student Access to the Facility and Clients. The Facility shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of the Facility as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. The Facility reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Facility's reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.

4.1. Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on the Facility premises, conduct himself or herself in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Facility premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at the Facility without express written permission from the Facility. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Facility and the Institution.
4.2. Timeliness. Student shall report to the Facility at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform the Facility and the Institution of Student's inability to report to the Facility as assigned.
4.3. Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by the Facility. Student shall display proper identification as directed by the Facility.
4.5. Personal Expenses. While at the Facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6. Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or the Facility, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at the Facility including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Facility and experience and supervision at the Facility.

Section 7.2 Obligations - shall be deleted in its entirety and replaced with the following: "To the extent permitted by the Constitution and laws of the State of Texas, including but not limited to the Public Information Act, Receiving Party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible."
7.1 Definition. "Confidential Information" means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party's possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.
7.2 Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it. The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.

BREACH. 1.2 Safety and Related Training. The Institution will provide Students with information and training regarding universal precautions which include, without limitation: (i) the hazards associated with blood and other potentially infectious materials; (ii) protective measures to be taken to minimize the risk of occupational exposure to blood borne pathogens; and (iii) appropriate action to take in an emergency involving exposure to blood and other potentially infectious materials.
5.1 Emergency Medical Services. If Student is injured or becomes ill while at the Facility, the Facility shall provide emergency or urgent medical care as appropriate, consistent with the Facility's capability and policies. In the event the Facility renders emergency or urgent medical care to Student, the Facility shall promptly notify the Institution that Student has been injured or become ill. The Facility shall bear no financial responsibility for charges associated with said injury, illness or treatment.
5.2 Immunizations. The Institution shall assure that Students have received, before reporting to the Facility, appropriate immunizations and vaccines.
5.3 OSHA Compliance. The Institution shall instruct Students regarding precautions and other procedures to protect Students, the Facility's clients and the Facility personnel in accordance with Occupational Safety and Health Administration ("OSHA") regulations.

2.4 Orientation. All Students assigned by the Institution to the Facility shall be required to complete the Facility's training and adhere to the Facility rules, regulations, policies and procedures. 2.6 Student Access to the Facility and Clients. The Facility shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of the Facility as reasonably required to support Students' clinical development and as permitted under applicable law. The Facility reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Facility's reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
STUDENTS' RESPONSIBILITIES. The Institution and the Facility shall instruct Students regarding Students' responsibilities associated with the Program at the Facility. These responsibilities shall include the following:

4.1 Conduct. Student shall, at all times while on the Facility premises, conduct himself or herself in a professional manner. Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Facility premises. Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at the Facility without express written permission from the Facility. Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Facility and the Institution.
4.2 Timeliness. Student shall report to the Facility at the assigned place and time. Student shall immediately inform the Facility and the Institution of Student's inability to report to the Facility as assigned.
4.3 Uniform and Identification. Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by the Facility. Student shall display proper identification as directed by the Facility.
4.5 Personal Expenses. While at the Facility, Student shall be responsible for Student's personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
4.6 Evaluation of Clinical Experience. Student shall, upon request of the Institution or the Facility, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at the Facility including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Facility and experience and supervision at the Facility.

16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality
Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement,
Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys' fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility's rights hereunder.

7.1 Definition. "Confidential Information" means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party's possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.
7.2 Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it. The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible. See Addendum A and Addendum B
The parties to this Agreement understand and acknowledge that Counterparty-65 is an institution of higher education and agency of the state of Washington, and as such, is subject to the Public Records Act, [state law] et seq. If Counterparty-65 receives a public records request for this agreement and/or for documents and/or materials provided to Counterparty-65 under this agreement, generally such information will be a public record and must be disclosed to the public records requester. However, Counterparty-65 agrees to notify Company/Vendor if it receives such a public records request and the date Counterparty-65 plans to release the records. If Company/Vendor fails to obtain a protective order from the applicable court prior to the time Counterparty-65 releases the records to the public records requester, Company/Vendor gives Counterparty-65 full authority to release the records on the date specified, and Company/Vendor understands it has thereby given up all rights to challenge the disclosure in any forum.

a.
