4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any "Confidential Information" of the Facility. "Confidential Information" means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information ("PHI") as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with the Facility's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as "Confidential Information").
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student's agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student's obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student's involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party's violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student's possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student's written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student's agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
10.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. 4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure .  Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure .	  The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of the Facility.  “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by the Facility, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.  Students will sign and comply with the Facility's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Any and all information disclosed by Facility, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY . Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information.  Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE . Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION .  This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student.  Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Facility; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Facility from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Facility to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Facility prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  At any time Facility requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH .  If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Facility shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity.  Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Facility’s rights hereunder.

"Confidential Information" means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party's possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.
7.2 Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it. The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

parts.text: 7.1. Definition. “ Confidential Information ” means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party’s possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.

7.2. Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it.  The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

parts.text:
4.7. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. Student will be asked to sign and comply with the Student Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement.
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure. The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos. “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure. Students will sign and comply with Exos's Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY. Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information. Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE. Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION. This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student. Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH. If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity. Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

parts.text: 7.1. Definition. “ Confidential Information ” means all information obtained by the receiving party related to or provided by the disclosing party or its affiliates, and all information derived therefrom, but excludes information that: (a) is or becomes available to the general public other than through a breach of duty to the disclosing party; (b) was lawfully in the receiving party’s possession prior to receipt under this Agreement; (b) is independently developed by the receiving party without reference to Confidential Information; or (c) is subsequently obtained from a third party without restriction or breach of an obligation to the disclosing party. Confidential Information of Exos includes, without limitation, any PHI disclosed to Institution.

7.2. Obligations. Receiving party will protect Confidential Information of the disclosing party with reasonable care and will not disclose it to any third party, or use it for any purpose, except as permitted under this Agreement. Receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to persons who need to know it who are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less restrictive than in this Section 7. Receiving party will be liable for any breach of this Section 7 by any person obtaining Confidential Information from it.  The foregoing notwithstanding, receiving party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent necessary to comply with any law or governmental order if it first notifies disclosing party and provides it with an opportunity to prevent or limit such disclosure. To the extent permitted by law, receiving party will destroy Confidential Information of the disclosing party upon request, other than backup copies not readily accessible.

excerpts.opening:
16.1. Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure .	  The Institution agrees to maintain confidentiality and shall not disclose any “Confidential Information” of Exos.  “ Confidential Information ” means any and all information disclosed by Exos, including, without limitation, to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information (“ PHI ”) as defined within HIPAA, disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such. Confidential Information shall not include information that is required to be disclosed by the Institution pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that the Institution shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.  Students will sign and comply with Exos' Confidentiality and Non-Disclosure Agreement, attached hereto as Exhibit A and incorporated herewith.
DESCRIPTION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Any and all information disclosed by Exos, including but not limited to financial information, customer lists, agreements, marketing information, business plans, trade secrets or other intellectual property, and including any protected health information as defined within the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), disclosed in any manner and regardless of whether such information is specifically labeled as such, is considered confidential information, unless such information falls within the exceptions set forth below (hereinafter such information shall be collectively referred to as “Confidential Information”).
AGREEMENT TO MAINTAIN CONFIDENTIALITY . Student agrees to hold any Confidential Information disclosed to the Student in confidence, to cause the Student’s agents or other third parties to hold such Confidential Information in confidence, and to use the same standard of care (but no less than a reasonable standard of care) used to protect its own proprietary and confidential information in protecting the Confidential Information.  Student shall not disclose Confidential Information to others or use it for purposes other than the Program.
LIMITED DISCLOSURE . Student agrees to limit disclosure of Confidential Information to those agents or other third parties necessary for the Program who have agreed to be bound by the obligations herein.
EFFECTIVE DATE AND LENGTH OF OBLIGATION .  This Student Confidentiality Agreement is effective as of the date of execution by Student.  Student’s obligation under this Student Confidentiality Agreement survives Student’s involvement in the Program.
EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  Confidential Information shall not include any information which (a) was publicly available at the time of disclosure; (b) became publicly available after disclosure without breach of this Student Confidentiality Agreement by the Student or by a third party’s violation of its obligation of confidentiality; (c) was in Student’s possession prior to disclosure, as evidenced by Student’s written records, and was not the subject of an earlier confidential relationship with Exos; (d) was rightfully acquired by Student after disclosure by Exos from a third party who was lawfully in possession of the information and was under no obligation to Exos to maintain its confidentiality; (e) is independently developed by Student’s agents who have not had access to the Confidential Information; or (f) is required to be disclosed by the Student pursuant to judicial order or other compulsion of law, provided that Student shall provide to Exos prompt notice of such order and comply with any protective order imposed on such disclosure.
RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION .  At any time Exos requests, Student shall return or destroy all documents, samples or other materials embodying Confidential Information, shall retain no copies thereof, and shall certify in writing that such destruction or return has been accomplished.
BREACH .  If Student breaches the term(s) of this Student Confidentiality Agreement, Exos shall (a) have the right to demand the immediate return of all Confidential Information; (b) have the right to seek to recover its actual damages incurred by reason of such breach, including, without limitation, its attorneys’ fees and costs; (c) be entitled to injunctive relief to prevent such breach or to otherwise enforce the terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement; and (d) have the right to pursue any other remedy available at law or in equity.  Failure to properly demand compliance with or performance of any terms of this Student Confidentiality Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of Exos’s rights hereunder.

Student's preparedness shall be measured by: (i) academic performance indicating an ability to understand what Student will observe and/or perform during the clinical placement; and (ii) appreciation of the nature and seriousness of the work Student will observe and/or perform.
1.4 Assigning Students to the Exos' facilities. After receiving the number of placements available for Students from Exos, the Institution shall submit information about the Students selected to be considered (with the approval of Exos) for the Program. Following review, Exos may approve the Students to be placed at one of Exos' facilities. The Institution shall notify the Students assigned to the Exos facility, and Exos of each Student's availability for participation in clinical experiences. Exos may place Students at one of its Affiliate's facilities. Upon any such placement,, this Agreement will be deemed to be made exclusively between the Institution and Exos' Affiliate identified on the Student's internship paperwork (offer letter, confidentiality agreement, or the like) and the other Exos Affiliate signatories hereto shall be automatically withdrawn as a party. The term "Affiliate" means an entity as of or after the Effective Date owned by, controlling, controlled by, or under common control with, directly or indirectly, a party, whether through ownership of voting securities or other equity interest, representation on its board of directors or other governing body, or by contract.
2.1 Clinical Experience. Exos shall provide clinical experience to Students which meets the standards of recognized accrediting agencies and the mutually accepted objectives of the Program.
2.2 Number of Placements. Exos shall have sole discretion to determine its capacity to accept Students for placement under this Agreement, whether such capacity is described in terms of the number of Students onsite at any one time, the number of hours of clinical supervision that Exos can provide over a period of time or other such description of capacity. Exos shall communicate such capacity to the Institution before Students may be assigned to Exos.
2.9 Inspections. Exos shall, upon reasonable request, permit inspection of its premises by the Institution.
2.10 Final Authority. Exos retains final authority for all aspects of operations at and management of Exos, including all aspects of client care.
3.2 Review and Evaluation of Affiliation. The Institution and Exos agree to review and evaluate any and all aspects of their affiliation at periodic intervals, and to work cooperatively to establish and maintain clinical experiences that meet their respective objectives. This Agreement may be amended or modified, pursuant to Section 7 below, to reflect changes in the parties' relationship.

excerpts.opening:
Orientation .  All Students assigned by the Institution to the Facility shall be required to complete the Facility’s training and adhere to the Facility rules, regulations, policies and procedures.  Failure to do so shall be grounds for Students’ immediate removal from participation in the Program.
Student Access to the Facility and Clients .  The Facility shall permit Students' access to any and all areas of the Facility as reasonably required to support Students’ clinical development and as permitted under applicable law.  The Facility reserves the right to refuse access to any Student who does not meet, in the Facility’s reasonable determination, its standards for safety, health or proper conduct.
Conduct .  Student shall, at all times while on the Facility premises, conduct himself or herself in a professional manner.  Student shall refrain from the improper use of alcohol or drugs, and shall not carry any firearms or other weapons while on the Facility premises.  Student shall not record, photograph, post on social media or otherwise image events on-site at the Facility without express written permission from the Facility.  Student shall abide by all policies, rules and regulations established by the Facility and the Institution.
Timeliness .  Student shall report to the Facility at the assigned place and time.  Student shall immediately inform the Facility and the Institution of Student's inability to report to the Facility as assigned.
Uniform and Identification .  Student shall wear the uniform or other clothing as directed by the Facility. Student shall display proper identification as directed by the Facility.
Personal Expenses .  While at the Facility, Student shall be responsible for Student’s personal expenses such as meals, travel, medical care and incidentals.
Evaluation of Clinical Experience .  Student shall, upon request of the Institution or the Facility, provide a candid evaluation of the clinical experience at the Facility including, without limitation, preparation for the on-site experience, orientation to the Facility and experience and supervision at the Facility.

B. For Cause. This Agreement may be terminated for cause as follows:

excerpts.opening:
B. For Cause. In the event the Institution or Exos fails in any substantial manner to perform as required herein, this Agreement may be terminated as described below:
Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time, upon material breach of any of its provisions by the other party; provided, however, that not less than thirty (30) days prior to termination, written notice shall be given by the non-breaching party to the breaching party that states the intention of the non-breaching party to terminate this Agreement, the nature of the material breach giving rise to termination and shall permit the breaching party reasonable opportunity to cure such material breach during said thirty (30) day period (" Cure Period ").
If the material breach is not resolved to the satisfaction of the non-breaching party during the Cure Period as provided in Section 6.2 (B)(1) above, the non-breaching party may immediately terminate this Agreement upon written notice to the breaching party.
In the event that termination of the Agreement by Exos pursuant to this Section 6.2 (B) disrupts the clinical experience of any Student(s) in the Program, the parties shall attempt, in good faith and using their best efforts, to continue Students’ clinical experiences, and this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect until such time as this Agreement may expire without disruption of said Students’ clinical experience. During any time period in which notice of termination has been given and existing Students are completing the Program, no new Student may be placed at any Exos facility.
